## Inbound maintenance email → Mortar
Reads the maintenance mailbox over IMAP and relays each email to Mortar as one event. Mortar does the rest: auto-replies are recognised from the headers, the sender is matched to the directory, severity is decided by rules.

Every request to Mortar is signed: the Code node builds the exact JSON string, the Crypto node signs that string (HMAC-SHA256, MORTAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET), and the HTTP node sends the same string as the raw body with `X-Mortar-Signature: sha256=<hex>`. Mortar rejects anything else with 401 and dedupes redeliveries by id.

Needs n8n env vars: `MORTAR_URL`, `MORTAR_WEBHOOK_SECRET` (and `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`). Set the IMAP credential on the trigger.

meta.description: Every email to the maintenance mailbox becomes a signed message.received event.
